project_context.core_task: Calculate complex payroll projections (masse salariale) with multi-scenario comparison.

headings.usage: Mainly for KPIs and high-level headers (tracking-tight, uppercase for section headers).

body.description: Sterile, highly legible for SaaS reading.

data.description: Used exclusively for numerical data, KPIs, and table cells for exact alignment.

typography.imports: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap'); /* For Cabinet Grotesk, use local assets or fallback to a standard wide sans like Space Grotesk/Syncopate if unavailable, but aim for architectural wide font */

surfaces_and_borders.style: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Minimal radii (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
surfaces_and_borders.shadows: None. Rely on 1px solid borders to establish hierarchy.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Avoid in this specific app to maintain clinical financial precision.

layout_architecture.structure: Split-pane Dashboard. Left-hand Control Panel (w-96) + Right-hand Canvas (flex-1). h-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-row bg-[#F4F4F5].

left_panel.content: Scenario selector tabs at top (Budget Initial, Scénario Croissance, Scénario Restrictif). Accordions or stacked sections for employee categories (Électriciens CCQ, Frigoristes CCQ, Employés Standard). Dense sliders for augmentation %, hours, headcount.

right_canvas.content: Top row: 3 Massive KPI Cards (Total Masse Salariale, Total Cotisations CCQ, Solde de Trésorerie Restant). Middle: Stacked Bar Chart. Bottom: Dense data table for Employee CRUD.

layout_architecture.spacing: Dense internally within components (gap-4, p-4), generous between macro-sections (gap-8).

component_guidelines.tabs: Blocky, segmented controls. Active state gets dark background (#09090B) with white text, inactive gets grey (#F4F4F5).
component_guidelines.sliders: Sharp square thumbs. Distinct track colors matching the employee category (Blue for Elec, Orange for Frig, Black for Std).
component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Bordered (#D4D4D8), white background. Values must be massive (text-4xl or 5xl) using IBM Plex Mono font. Label on top, value below.
component_guidelines.chart: Recharts Stacked Bar. Monthly breakdown. Tooltips must have squared corners and 1px borders. No soft shadows.
component_guidelines.table: Dense layout, uppercase headers (tracking-wider, text-xs), right-aligned Mono numbers. 1px borders.
component_guidelines.buttons: Square edges. Primary actions in #0055FF, hover: opacity-90.

motion.strategy: Instantaneous feel. Use 150ms ease-out transitions for interactions.
motion.sliders: Chart and KPIs must update in real-time as the slider moves. Avoid debounce if possible to maintain a fluid, zero page-reload feel.

images.description: Professional avatar for header or bottom of sidebar

instructions_to_main_agent: Write code in .js files, NOT .tsx (use standard React JSX).
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Add custom fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css.
Build a unified React state object to hold base scenarios ('Budget Initial', 'Scénario Croissance', 'Scénario Restrictif') and let the sliders override them dynamically.
Use Recharts (`recharts` package) for the interactive stacked bar chart showing monthly salary cost breakdown.
Strictly separate standard employees from CCQ union employees in data structure and visualization colors.
All UI text, labels, and dummy data MUST be strictly in French.
Implement real-time updates: as sliders (augmentation salaire %, heures supplémentaires, nouveaux recrutements) are dragged, the chart and KPIs immediately re-render.
Include CRUD functionality (Add/Edit/Delete buttons) in the employee table at the bottom of the right canvas.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transitions to specific elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: left; } not center).
NEVER use placeholder text for logos or images; use provided URLs.
NEVER use generic AI emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
All interactive elements (buttons, sliders, tabs) MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
